_comment: The agent_v2 carrier (task T0065, docs/AGENT_V2.md): frozen identities of its variants and host evaluations. Production default is agent_v2_p2xxl_direct, confirmed by T0083 release gate where general PPO policy G was not shown to differ from D (+0.11 pp [-1.16%, +1.38%]).

actor.source: T0059 pool-v2 large-V actor, aligned reference16 export (T0062)

predictor.dispatch: dedicated n02-n08, n10, n12, n15; general at 9, 11, 13, 14

search.status: experimental: no setting is validated until an eight-worker preflight passes

required_host_evaluations.name: new-carrier baseline, actor-direct
required_host_evaluations.question: the redesigned carrier against the deployed actor-direct bot with the same actor
required_host_evaluations.caveat: a carrier comparison: P, resolver and simulator change together; not a single-factor mechanism result

required_host_evaluations.name: search on the new carrier (deferred)
required_host_evaluations.question: only after the search deficit T0064 measured is diagnosed (real-engine continuations, fixed-work trees on agent_v2); reference16 is excluded (T0064: -14.76 pp vs direct, -10.10 vs WideAct16)
required_host_evaluations.rule: equal-time packages, one Bonferroni family, fresh seeds

host_gate.preflight: bots/meow_rl/aligned/preflight.py pattern: counts 2/5/8/15, 16 maps each, every variant, all-seat faults, counter coverage
host_gate.startup: every served team count's P model is linked into one binary: measure the 2,000 ms first reply at 15 teams

production_default: agent_v2_p2xxl_direct (actor-direct). Confirmed by T0083 release gate (reports/host/agent_v2_release_gate/REPORT.md): G - D is not shown (+0.11 pp [-1.16%, +1.38%]), so D remains production default per frozen promotion rule.

T0077.verdict: Specialists S rejected; general policy G confirmed superior to S and I

T0079.verdict: Search conclusively hurts vs direct play; direct inference retained

T0083.verdict: G does not help vs D; agent_v2_p2xxl_direct remains production default

variants_note.agent_v2_p2xxl_search_r16: diagnostic only (contract tests and fixed-work replay); not a screening arm
